notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood" at completion stage 1, but none of its walkthrough pages are written: the contents page links Sequence 01 to Sequence 09, two Desmond sections, The Truth, Collectibles, many side-mission pages and The Da Vinci Disappearance, yet the only written subpages are Weapons (about 10,900 characters), Achievements and trophies (about 9,900), Mechanics (about 9,500), Abilities, perks, bonuses (about 8,900), Maps (about 7,500), Scoring and leveling (about 5,900), Controls (about 4,700), Table of Contents (about 3,300), Characters (about 1,700) and Multiplayer (about 1,000). So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. Chapters here are grouped from those StrategyWiki page names (CC BY-SA 4.0), reworded in our own words; the attribution credits this. assassinscreed.fandom.com answers the API under "Assassin's Creed: Brotherhood", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500); names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's entry is the 2010 game (id 10064, slug assassins-creed-brotherhood-2); its description text is a Digital Deluxe Edition store blurb. RAWG also lists the Copernicus Conspiracy and The Da Vinci Disappearance as separate entries. Steam: app 48190 exists, but its achievement schema is empty, so steam is set to None; RAWG lists PC and Steam sells the game, but no achievement list could be fetched.
